name: L1_L2_SUCCESSOR_CONTRACT_DESIGN

scope.purpose: Define the exact post-freeze L1/L2 successor set required by DEV-03 L3 without mutating frozen Phase-2 predecessors or changing L4/L5 operation.
out_of_scope: rewriting Registry v2, Archive v5, canonical-model-record-v2 or Phase-2 successor/refreeze evidence

design_principles: Frozen predecessors remain immutable and readable.
Successor acquisition and storage are introduced on explicit versioned channels.
Provider-native parameter/product/level/time identity is preserved before any derivation.
Missing or ambiguous evidence is explicit and never zero-filled or false-clear.
Historical reconstruction remains causal and uses one as_of cutoff per evaluated issue state.
L4/L5 authority remains v16-c3-v9 throughout DEV-03.

AUD-20260928-01-F02.decision: Introduce one new model semantic, convective_precipitation, in relevant-meteorology-v3. Do not create a model semantic that claims observed thunder/event truth.

AUD-20260928-01-F03.decision: Replace divergent interval normalization behavior on the successor path with one native-interval-resolution-v1 contract and integer interval_seconds authority.

AUD-20260928-01-F04.decision: Introduce l2-l3-meteorology-read-contract-v1 with complete native identity, causal provenance, exact lead and interval requirements.

AUD-20260928-01-F05.decision: Introduce forecast-lead-identity-v1. Acquisition leads remain strict integral hours; lead_seconds becomes the exact L2 authority. Truncating int() coercion is forbidden.

successor_set.reason: Add convective_precipitation while separating provider capability from acquisition policy.
Acquire Registry-v3 fields on the retained acquisition grid without changing the frozen Phase-2 plan.
Carry strict lead identity, Registry-v3 availability and new native fields without changing the operational v2 payload.
Availability v2 is code-bound to Registry v2; v3 must materialize Registry-v3 capability/policy states while preserving the same closed missingness semantics.
Provide one lossless lead-duration authority across public payload, canonical record, ensemble storage and Archive v6.
Centralize native interval resolution and make interval_seconds authoritative.
Bind exact lead identity and central interval resolution for deterministic successor records.
Bind causal private availability to Registry v3 and the v6 identity surface without weakening v2 missingness semantics.
Use forecast-lead-identity-v1 and native-interval-resolution-v1 for ensemble members, availability and aggregates.
Persist exact lead/interval/native identity while preserving revision-event causality.
Expose complete provider-format-independent L3 read identity without mutating the historical Phase-3 interface gate.

reused_unchanged.reason: F02-F05 do not require a cadence/horizon change; new fields use the already retained model/lead grid.
Run/valid/model/member logical identity remains correct; exact lead_seconds is a validated duration, not a new logical forecast key.
A->B->A, exact replay, private visibility and as_of causality remain valid.
Atomic source-set semantics remain valid under ensemble v3.
F02-F05 do not alter GEFS evidence publication semantics.
Transfer hashing/readback semantics remain valid; the v3 channel requires its own receipt but not a new readback algorithm.
Frozen historical acceptance evidence remains immutable and is not superseded as audit history.

new_semantic.meaning: Provider-native convective precipitation amount over its native accumulation interval.

ICON-D2.provider_product: DWD ICON-D2 Open Data raw GRIB2
ICON-D2.interval_policy: preserve native step metadata; resolve only through native-interval-resolution-v1

ICON-EU.provider_product: DWD ICON-EU Open Data raw GRIB2
ICON-EU.interval_policy: preserve native step metadata; resolve only through native-interval-resolution-v1

ECMWF-IFS.note: Current IFS Open Data atmosphere inventory used by this project exposes total precipitation but not convective precipitation cp.

GFS.explicitly_excluded_alias: CPRAT because it is a rate semantic, not an accumulation amount

GEFS-control.note: Current GEFS atmospheric products used by the project expose APCP but not ACPCP.

ICON-D2-EPS.activation_gate: DEV03-PREP07 resource/network budget plus dedicated source-path acceptance
ICON-D2-EPS.note: Do not relabel total precipitation from the current Open-Meteo EPS path as convective precipitation.

ECMWF-AIFS.rule: Adding AIFS requires a later explicit provider/source-path successor and does not change this WP02 contract.

step_unit_contract.source: WMO GRIB2 Code Table 4.4 / ecCodes-compatible values

precedence: complete explicit interval_start_utc plus interval_end_utc, validated against field valid time
complete startStep plus endStep plus recognized stepUnits
stepRange only when its unit is explicit or an independent recognized stepUnits value removes ambiguity
instantaneous stepType may yield a zero-second point only when no contradictory interval evidence exists
forbidden_inference: derive interval duration from forecast lead
derive interval duration from parameter alias such as 10fg3 or 10fg6
assume unitless stepRange values are hours
partially combine conflicting explicit and native interval metadata

f04_l2_l3_read_contract_v1.causal_read_rule: All relations for one historical issue state come from one adapter/session bound to one as_of=T.
f04_l2_l3_read_contract_v1.legacy_adapter_rule: v1-v5 history may add only values exactly derivable from persisted timestamps/native metadata; missing native identity remains null and explicitly partial.
f04_l2_l3_read_contract_v1.primary_input_rule: An analyzer that requires a missing identity dimension must reject legacy_partial rows rather than infer it.

f05_forecast_lead_identity_v1.current_project_policy: All acquired forecast leads are integral hours.

forecast_lead_hours.rule: must be an integer value and not bool/string/float

f05_forecast_lead_identity_v1.l1_invariant: valid_time_utc - run_time_utc == forecast_lead_seconds exactly and forecast_lead_seconds % 3600 == 0
rejected_examples: a value that differs from run/valid timestamp delta

l2_authority.source: validated exact timestamp delta and matching successor payload identity

l2_compatibility.rule: derived from lead_seconds / 3600.0 and never used as the semantic authority

f05_forecast_lead_identity_v1.legacy_adapter_rule: A legacy lead_hours value is accepted only when finite, mathematically integral, and exactly consistent with run/valid timestamps. Never use int() truncation.
f05_forecast_lead_identity_v1.future_subhour_rule: A future provider needing sub-hour forecast leads requires a new lead-identity contract version rather than weakening v1.

public_collection.provider_request_rule: Use one shared provider retrieval pass where possible. Do not duplicate existing provider downloads merely to create v3 records.
public_collection.successor_channel: collector-model-bundle-v3 is a separate shadow sidecar/transfer channel
public_collection.additional_provider_requests: Only fields newly required by Registry v3 may add provider traffic.

transfer.legacy_receipt: existing models v2 verified transfer receipt unchanged
transfer.successor_receipt: v3 shadow payload gets its own verified receipt/readback identity

private_promotion.legacy: existing v2 promotion/current forecast path unchanged
private_promotion.successor: v3 shadow promotion uses a separate namespace and may not replace operational latest pointers during DEV-03

persistence.legacy_archive: Archive v5 continues unchanged for the operational/compatibility path
persistence.successor_archive: Archive v6 is written in a separate shadow root during WP03 acceptance

l2_l3_read.historical_sources: read-only Archive v1-v5 through exact legacy adapter
l2_l3_read.duplicate_rule: when the same revision_event_id exists in v5 and v6, expose the exact v6 successor row and suppress the legacy duplicate
l2_l3_read.mixed_as_of_rule: both legacy and v6 sources must be evaluated against the same as_of cutoff

implementation_order_for_DEV03_WP03: Implement shared forecast-lead-identity-v1 and relevant-meteorology-v3 contracts.
Implement collector-model-bundle-v3 shadow sidecar without changing v2 operational output.
Implement Archive v6 shadow persistence preserving revision-event causality.
Run cross-repository regression and representative/live successor acceptance before WP04.
stop_conditions: Do not implement a model event-truth semantic in place of convective precipitation.
Do not start a v3 field acquisition path unless provider-native identity and interval metadata can be preserved.
Do not accept non-integral or coercible-only forecast lead values.
Do not create normalized interval boundaries from incomplete or guessed evidence.
Do not expose legacy_partial identity as exact L3 input.
Do not rewrite v1-v5 Parquet or backdate private first_seen.
Do not change v16-c3-v9 or notification behavior.

requirements: F02-F05 each map to explicit successor artifacts.
Legacy and successor transfer/persistence namespaces are separate during acceptance.
Historical dual-read never invents missing identity or first_seen chronology.

acceptance_metadata_policy: Repository-specific CI run IDs are recorded in PROJECT_STATE/PROJECT_HANDOFF, not in this byte-identical shared contract.
